bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-ui-05849c)" || exit 62
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 1c7d6a7888b3cd118e5f522d3337f1acb50d509a || exit 64
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_link_video_caption_smoke.py)" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_video_caption_smoke.py)" || exit 65
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-video-live.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py >"$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 66
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 67
if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_video_caption_smoke >"$tmp/test.out" 2>&1; then
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 69
 echo LINK_VIDEO_PRIVATE_REGISTER=PASS
 echo USERBOT_SESSION=ACTIVE
else
 reason="$(sed -n 's/^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=//p' "$tmp/test.out" | head -1)"
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 71
 case "$reason" in
  *EXISTING_DRAFT_BLOCKED*)exit 81;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_MENU*|*MENU_NOT_FOUND*)exit 82;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_VIDEO*)exit 83;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_PAIR*)exit 84;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_REGISTER*)exit 85;;
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND*)exit 86;;
  *)exit 87;;
 esac
fi
